svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the board to 90 x 50 mm with a fine saw; file the edges smooth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure from the centre lines. The top face carries the cell and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the breakouts; the driver board hangs under the other face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fixing holes: four 4.3 mm at 40 and 18 mm each side of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Driver board holes: four 3.2 mm at -13 and 22 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: along, 11 mm each side across. Match your driver board's holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Strap slots: two 12 x 3 mm on the cross line, 5.6 mm toward the back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge and 21.6 mm toward the front edge. Drill and file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay out on the top: cell holder along the front half; module,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sensor breakouts, power parts and capacitor along the back half.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the top face sits on the four standoff ends, held by four M4

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the board drops onto the standoffs without forcing.
